# Dependencies of scripts/cuevault.py, pinned with their hashes for
#   pip install --require-hashes -r scripts/cuevault-requirements.txt
# The versions are the newest that still support Python 3.9, the system Python of macOS. The hashes
# cover every CPython wheel for macOS (arm64; cffi also x86_64), manylinux x86_64 and aarch64 and
# Windows x86_64, and the sdists. cryptography ships no wheel for Intel Macs, which build it from
# the sdist and need Rust for that.
